toeplitz_kernel_formalization_2026_11_01.target: For n>=0 and T:Matrix (Fin(n+1)) (Fin(n+1)) Complex, assume PosSemidef T, T i.succ j.succ=T i.castSucc j.castSucc for all Fin n indices, and rank T=n. Equivalently every nonzero kernel vector has its ordinary ascending-coefficient polynomial roots on the unit circle.
toeplitz_kernel_formalization_2026_11_01.conventions: Full Hermitian two-sided Toeplitz, not the one-sided Taylor Toeplitz/PF matrix. Ordinary complex coefficients p=sum v_j X^j; explicit nonzero polynomial/vector. No zeta coefficients or all-rank positivity assumption.
toeplitz_kernel_formalization_2026_11_01.DH_analogue: Identical finite linear-algebra theorem for any DH-derived matrix whenever its PSD, Toeplitz and corank-one hypotheses hold. toeplitz_kernel_formalization_2026_11_01.method: Attempt direct shift-isometry proof: divide p by X-z; equal Toeplitz energies for q and Xq, together with T(p)=0 and Hermitian symmetry, imply (1-|z|^2)Q(q)=0. Corank one plus degree strictness excludes q in the kernel. No atomic representation is assumed.
